scope: finite conditional event and fee ledger; not performance modeling or measurements
assumptions: Conditional layout only; no native traffic or PMD layout measurement.
Each next RX in a region follows previous object return.
PASS changes packet identity, never physical mapping generation.
Retire follows DMA/reference drain, cache return eligibility and necessary revoke.
READ means an O2-class ordinary construction satisfying stipulated permissions, not the unmodified RFC08/22 leaf permissions.
Unmodified RFC08/22 maps a full PMD CACHE|READ|WRITE; direct use requires T_RW authorizing B for whole-PMD RW.
READ-only T requires an ordinary read-only adaptation with its full cost included; that interface is not implemented here.
Whole region H including headroom, tailroom and metadata must be within the authorized T scope.
All target TX accepted is a conditional fixture outcome, not online free knowledge that the SQ will accept; partial acceptance/failure paths are outside this ledger.
G/L and other symbolic terms in CPU formulas are residual CPU work not already charged through d/x/s/F/K/h; F includes B map/revoke, so L cannot charge that work twice.
Memory bytes, memory retention time, bandwidth and completion constraints remain separate unknowns outside CPU formulas.

checks.scope: finite bookkeeping semantic and arithmetic checks only

candidate_scope: User proposed a general organization idea, without a distinct controller. This particular cumulative-excess version is ordinary O3 by definition; no separate candidate implementation or equivalence test and no whole-family coverage claim.
online_information: current event, history, frozen common F/R parameters; no future reuse count
offline_bound_scope: knows final per-key r; min(rR,F) bounds only normalized excess, not full cost

symbol_domains.K: nonnegative, unmeasured target pool full lifecycle CPU cost
symbol_domains.h: nonnegative, unmeasured per-B-forward lookup CPU cost
symbol_domains.G,L,U: nonnegative residual CPU costs not already included in d/x/s/F/K/h; signed differences unconstrained; F map/revoke work must not be charged again in L
symbol_domains.memory_bandwidth_completion: separate unmeasured quantities, not summed into CPU units

conditional_comparisons.O1: 10d + 10R + K + G_O1 + L_O1 + 2U (x=min(x,s) for frozen case)
conditional_comparisons.K_cancellation_condition: O1 and O3 actually use the identical target pool lifecycle; otherwise retain K_O3-K_O1
conditional_comparisons.source_cost_warning: Do not cancel three-RQ or aligned-PMD source layout costs against native O0 without evidence.
